notes: Services are isolated with their own stores and use the Event Bus for cross-service communication. Task status transitions enforce forward-only. No HTTP logic in services and no external dependencies. Missing Notification Service and API Router; no event subscriptions implemented, so notifications won’t fire. EventBus is untyped (payload: any) and synchronous. Minimal validation (e.g., assign doesn’t verify user/project membership). Minor readability issue in ProjectService.removeMember (shadowed variable). Overall clean TypeScript but incomplete system.
